sections.overview:
SocialCampainTool is an automated social media posting and campaign management solution built on PHP. It streamlines the process of scheduling and managing posts across social media platforms. Designed for teams handling multiple campaigns, this tool reduces manual posting work and helps maintain consistent social media presence.
Schedule and automate social media posts across multiple platforms
Manage multiple marketing campaigns from a centralized dashboard
Reduce manual effort in daily social media posting tasks
Maintain consistent posting schedules for brand accounts
- **Duration**: 2 weeks
- **Objective**: Increase brand awareness and drive traffic to the new product launch
- **Target Audience**: Tech enthusiasts, sustainability advocates, B2B clients
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/solutionok/SocialCampainTool`
sections.usage:
```
Create a 2-week social media campaign for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Include daily posts, hashtags, and engagement strategies. Use the following data points: [DATA]. Format the output as a detailed plan with clear action items.
```
